name: Phenoxypropazine

summary: Phenoxypropazine was removed from the market in the United Kingdom in 1966 due to liver damage [3]. A small computer model, rather than tests on people, gave it a low score for liver harm and a medium score for heart harm [M]. Similar drugs have also been pulled from the market in other countries for liver harm, or carry strong warnings for misuse and heart harm [3][4][5].
